content.text: {"id":"29d0377a-82f9-4822-8fca-02d50593b79e","audio_id":"45c15644-ce80-4d6e-b7d1-00a68f5901d4","status":"complete","created_at":"2026-11-16T07:14:41Z","answer":"The chorus is a connected four-line melody, not mostly isolated word chanting: the line moves up and then down, with clear cadential endings. It returns twice (about 0:00–0:20 and 0:58–1:18), while the verse (about 0:20–0:57) sits lower and is more speech-like and rhythmically plain. The vocal is steady and clearly articulated; “ball” and “car” sound clean, with no obvious rushed words. A four-on-the-floor electronic beat, bouncy bass, bright synth chords, and electronic percussion give it a distinct dance pulse, and the chorus is a clearly defined longer section. There is no long instrumental gap; a brief instrumental fade and clear outro finish the recording rather than leaving it unfinished."}
